Field.content:
class Field (R : Type) where
  zero    : R
  one     : R
  add     : R → R → R
  mul     : R → R → R
  opp     : R → R

  add_comm    : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc   : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero    : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  zero_add    : ∀ x, add zero x = x
  add_opp     : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero

  mul_comm    : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc   : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one     : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l      : ∀ x y z, mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)

  opp_add     : ∀ x y, opp (add x y) = add (opp x) (opp y)
  mul_opp_one : ∀ x, mul (opp one) x = opp x
  opp_opp     : ∀ x, opp (opp x) = x

VSpace.content:
class VSpace (R : Type) [Field R] (V : Type) where
  zeroV : V
  addV  : V → V → V
  oppV  : V → V
  smul  : R → V → V

  addV_comm  : ∀ u v, addV u v = addV v u
  addV_assoc : ∀ u v w, addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)
  addV_zero  : ∀ u, addV u zeroV = u
  addV_opp   : ∀ u, addV u (oppV u) = zeroV

  smul_addV  : ∀ a u v, smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
  addR_smul  : ∀ a b u, smul (a +R b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
  mul_smul   : ∀ a b u, smul (a *R b) u = smul a (smul b u)
  one_smul   : ∀ u, smul Field.one u = u
  smul_zero  : ∀ a, smul a zeroV = zeroV
  opp_smul_one : ∀ u, oppV u = smul (Field.opp Field.one) u

•V.content: notation:70 a " •V " u => VSpace.smul a u

subV.content:
def subV {R : Type} {V : Type} [Field R] [VSpace R V] (u v : V) : V :=
  VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)

Inner.content:
class Inner (R : Type) (V : Type) [Field R] [VSpace R V] where
  ip : V → V → R

  lin_left_add  : ∀ u v w,
    ip (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v) w = (ip u w) +R (ip v w)
  lin_left_smul : ∀ a u v,
    ip (VSpace.smul (R := R) (V := V) a u) v = a *R (ip u v)

  lin_right_add  : ∀ u v w,
    ip u (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) v w) = (ip u v) +R (ip u w)
  lin_right_smul : ∀ a u v,
    ip u (VSpace.smul (R := R) (V := V) a v) = a *R (ip u v)

  symm : ∀ u v, ip u v = ip v u

variables instances.content: variable [Field R] [VSpace R V] [Inner R V]

ip_neg_left.content:
theorem ip_neg_left (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
    (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) u) v
    = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) := by
  -- rewrite -u as (-1) • u then pull scalar out
  have h := Inner.lin_left_smul (R := R) (V := V)
    (a := Field.opp (Field.one)) u v
  -- conclude using mul_opp_one
  simpa [VSpace.opp_smul_one, Field.mul_opp_one] using h

ip_neg_right.content:
theorem ip_neg_right (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u
    (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
    = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) := by
  have h := Inner.lin_right_smul (R := R) (V := V)
    (a := Field.opp (Field.one)) u v
  simpa [VSpace.opp_smul_one, Field.mul_opp_one] using h

ip_add_add.content:
theorem ip_add_add (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u)
       +R (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
  -- Expand in the right argument first, then in the left
  have H := Inner.lin_right_add (R := R) (V := V)
    (u := VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v) (v := u) (w := v)
  -- expand each left-additivity
  have H1 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v) u
      = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u :=
    Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V) (u := u) (v := v) (w := u)
  have H2 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v) v
      = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v :=
    Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V) (u := u) (v := v) (w := v)
  simpa [H1, H2, Field.add_assoc] using H

ip_sub_sub.content:
theorem ip_sub_sub (u v : V) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u))
       +R (Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
  -- expand on right then left, and use negation rewrites
  have H := Inner.lin_right_add (R := R) (V := V)
    (u := subV (R := R) (V := V) u v) (v := u)
    (w := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
  have H1 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v) u =
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u
        +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
              (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) u := by
      simpa using
        Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V)
          (u := u)
          (v := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (w := u)
  have H2 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
      = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
              (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
              (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) := by
      simpa using
        Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V)
          (u := u)
          (v := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (w := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
  -- mixed terms
  have Huv_neg :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) u
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u) :=
    ip_neg_left (v := u) v
  have Huu :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) :=
    ip_neg_right (u := u) v
  -- simplify ⟪-v,-v⟫ to ⟪v,v⟫ via two negations and opp_opp
  have Hvv1 :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
                        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v) :=
    ip_neg_right (u := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v
  have Hvv2 :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v) :=
    ip_neg_left v v
  have Hvv :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v := by
    -- combine Hvv1 and Hvv2, then use opp_opp
    have :
        Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
          (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
      simpa [Hvv2] using Hvv1
    simpa [Field.opp_opp] using this
  -- assemble
  simpa [H1, H2, Huv_neg, Huu, Hvv, Field.add_assoc, Field.add_comm]
    using H

pythagoras.content:
theorem pythagoras (u v : V)
  (h : Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v = Field.zero) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v) := by
  -- Expand ⟪u+v,u+v⟫ and cancel the cross terms using symmetry
  have H := ip_add_add (R := R) (V := V) u v
  -- cross term symmetry
  have hvu : Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u = Field.zero := by
    simpa [Inner.symm (R := R) (V := V) v u] using h
  -- ((⟪u,u⟫ + 0) + (0 + ⟪v,v⟫)) → ⟪u,u⟫ + ⟪v,v⟫
  have :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.zero)
            +R (Field.zero +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
    simp [H, h, hvu]
  simpa [Field.add_zero, Field.zero_add, Field.add_comm, Field.add_assoc] using this

parallelogram.content:
theorem parallelogram (u v : V) :
  (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
     +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
          (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
          (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v))
    = (((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u)
         +R (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v))
       +R ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u))
           +R ((Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v))
               +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v))) := by
  have H1 := ip_add_add (R := R) (V := V) u v
  have H2 := ip_sub_sub (R := R) (V := V) u v
  simp [H1, H2]

subV.content: Definition subV {VS : VSpace} (u v : V0) := addV u (oppV v).

⟪,⟫.content: Notation "⟪ x , y ⟫" := (ip x y) (at level 80).

ip_neg_left.content:
Lemma ip_neg_left : forall u v, ⟪-V u, v⟫ = -R ⟪u, v⟫.
    Proof.
      intros u v.
      rewrite opp_smul_one.
      rewrite lin_left_smul.
      now rewrite mulR_opp_one.
    Qed.

ip_neg_right.content:
Lemma ip_neg_right : forall u v, ⟪u, -V v⟫ = -R ⟪u, v⟫.
    Proof.
      intros u v.
      rewrite opp_smul_one.
      rewrite lin_right_smul.
      now rewrite mulR_opp_one.
    Qed.

ip_add_add.content:
Lemma ip_add_add : forall u v,
      ⟪u +V v, u +V v⟫ = ((⟪u,u⟫ +R ⟪v,u⟫) +R (⟪u,v⟫ +R ⟪v,v⟫)).
    Proof.
      intros u v.
      pose proof (lin_right_add (u +V v) u v) as H.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u v u) as H1.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u v v) as H2.
      rewrite H1, H2 in H.
      exact H.
    Qed.

ip_sub_sub.content:
Lemma ip_sub_sub : forall u v,
      ⟪u -V v, u -V v⟫ = ((⟪u,u⟫ +R (-R ⟪v,u⟫)) +R ((-R ⟪u,v⟫) +R ⟪v,v⟫)).
    Proof.
      intros u v.
      unfold subV in *.
      pose proof (lin_right_add (addV u (oppV v)) u (oppV v)) as H.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u (oppV v) u) as H1.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u (oppV v) (oppV v)) as H2.
      rewrite H1, H2 in H.
      (* Simplify the mixed terms *)
      rewrite (ip_neg_left v u) in H.
      rewrite (ip_neg_right u v) in H.
      (* Simplify ⟪-v, -v⟫ to ⟪v,v⟫ using two negation lemmas *)
      rewrite (ip_neg_right (oppV v) v) in H.
      rewrite (ip_neg_left v v) in H.
      rewrite oppR_opp in H.
      exact H.
    Qed.

pythagoras.content:
Lemma pythagoras : forall u v,
      ⟪u,v⟫ = zeroR ->
      ⟪u +V v, u +V v⟫ = (⟪u,u⟫ +R ⟪v,v⟫).
    Proof.
      intros u v Huv.
      pose proof (ip_add_add u v) as H.
      assert (Hvu : ⟪v,u⟫ = zeroR) by (now rewrite <- symm).
      rewrite Huv, Hvu in H.
      rewrite addR_zero in H.
      rewrite zeroR_add in H.
      exact H.
    Qed.

parallelogram.content:
Lemma parallelogram : forall u v,
      (⟪u +V v, u +V v⟫ +R ⟪u -V v, u -V v⟫)
        = (((⟪u,u⟫ +R ⟪v,u⟫) +R (⟪u,v⟫ +R ⟪v,v⟫))
           +R ((⟪u,u⟫ +R (-R ⟪v,u⟫)) +R ((-R ⟪u,v⟫) +R ⟪v,v⟫))).
    Proof.
      intros u v.
      pose proof (ip_add_add u v) as H1.
      pose proof (ip_sub_sub u v) as H2.
      rewrite H1, H2.
      reflexivity.
    Qed.

mulR_opp_one.content: mulR_opp_one : forall x, mulR (oppR oneR) x = oppR x

oppR_opp.content: ; oppR_opp : forall x, oppR (oppR x) = x

lin_left_add.content: lin_left_add  : forall u v w, (ip (u +V v) w) = ((ip u w) +R (ip v w));

lin_left_smul.content: lin_left_smul : forall a u v, (ip (a •V u) v) = (a *R (ip u v));

lin_right_add.content: lin_right_add  : forall u v w, (ip u (v +V w)) = ((ip u v) +R (ip u w));

lin_right_smul.content: lin_right_smul : forall a u v, (ip u (a •V v)) = (a *R (ip u v));

symm.content: symm : forall u v, ip u v = ip v u

opp_smul_one.content: opp_smul_one : forall u, oppV u = smul (oppR oneR) u

addR_zero.content: addR_zero  : forall x, addR x zeroR = x;

zeroR_add.content: zeroR_add  : forall x, addR zeroR x = x;

  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u))
       +R (Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
lean.proof:
have H := Inner.lin_right_add (R := R) (V := V)
    (u := subV (R := R) (V := V) u v) (v := u)
    (w := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
  have H1 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v) u =

        Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V)
          (u := u)
          (v := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (w := u)
  have H2 :
    Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (subV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
      = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
              (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
              (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) := by
      simpa using
        Inner.lin_left_add (R := R) (V := V)
          (u := u)
          (v := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (w := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
  have Huv_neg :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) u
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v u) :=
    ip_neg_left (v := u) v
  have Huu :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v) :=
    ip_neg_right (u := u) v
  have Hvv1 :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
                        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v) :=
    ip_neg_right (u := VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v
  have Hvv2 :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v) v
        = Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v) :=
    ip_neg_left v v
  have Hvv :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v := by
    have :
        Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
          (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
          (VSpace.oppV (R := R) (V := V) v)
        = Field.opp (Field.opp (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
      simpa [Hvv2] using Hvv1
    simpa [Field.opp_opp] using this
  simpa [H1, H2, Huv_neg, Huu, Hvv, Field.add_assoc, Field.add_comm]
    using H

Lemma ip_sub_sub : forall u v,
      ⟪u -V v, u -V v⟫ = ((⟪u,u⟫ +R (-R ⟪v,u⟫)) +R ((-R ⟪u,v⟫) +R ⟪v,v⟫)).
coq.proof:
Proof.
      intros u v.
      unfold subV in *.
      pose proof (lin_right_add (addV u (oppV v)) u (oppV v)) as H.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u (oppV v) u) as H1.
      pose proof (lin_left_add u (oppV v) (oppV v)) as H2.
      rewrite H1, H2 in H.
      (* Simplify the mixed terms *)
      rewrite (ip_neg_left v u) in H.
      rewrite (ip_neg_right u v) in H.
      (* Simplify ⟪-v, -v⟫ to ⟪v,v⟫ using two negation lemmas *)
      rewrite (ip_neg_right (oppV v) v) in H.
      rewrite (ip_neg_left v v) in H.
      rewrite oppR_opp in H.
      exact H.
    Qed.

theorem pythagoras (u v : V)
  (h : Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u v = Field.zero) :
  Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
      (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
    = (Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v) := by

  have :
      Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        (VSpace.addV (R := R) (V := V) u v)
        = ((Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) u u +R Field.zero)
            +R (Field.zero +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v)) := by
    simp [H, h, hvu]
  simpa [Field.add_zero, Field.zero_add, Field.add_comm, Field.add_assoc] using this

Lemma pythagoras : forall u v,
      ⟪u,v⟫ = zeroR ->
      ⟪u +V v, u +V v⟫ = (⟪u,u⟫ +R ⟪v,v⟫).
coq.proof:
Proof.
      intros u v Huv.
      pose proof (ip_add_add u v) as H.
      assert (Hvu : ⟪v,u⟫ = zeroR) by (now rewrite <- symm).
      rewrite Huv, Hvu in H.
      rewrite addR_zero in H.
      rewrite zeroR_add in H.
      exact H.
    Qed.

               +R Inner.ip (R := R) (V := V) v v))) := by

Lemma parallelogram : forall u v,
      (⟪u +V v, u +V v⟫ +R ⟪u -V v, u -V v⟫)
        = (((⟪u,u⟫ +R ⟪v,u⟫) +R (⟪u,v⟫ +R ⟪v,v⟫))

      pose proof (ip_sub_sub u v) as H2.
